paper.title_en: Global quark spin polarizations and correlations in relativistic heavy ion collisions
paper.abstract_en: Measurements by the STAR collaboration of global $\Lambda$ hyperon polarization and $\phi,K^{*0}$ meson spin alignment in heavy ion collisions have confirmed the global polarization of quark matter and indicated strong spin correlations between quarks and antiquarks. These discoveries have opened new avenues for studying quark spin correlations and the properties of QGP in high-energy physics. A systematic method has been developed to describe spin correlations in quark matter, classifying them into local and long-range correlations. It is shown that the effective quark spin correlations contain genuine spin correlations originating directly from the dynamical process as well as those induced by averaging other degrees of freedom. Based on this framework, we present a comprehensive study of spin polarization of hadrons with different spins including vector mesons, spin-1/2 hyperons and hyperon-(anti)hyperon spin correlations in heavy ion collisions. The aim of this contribution is to summarize main results and discuss future prospects.
